title: Constructor chaining in inheritance
answer: Constructor chaining is the sequence in which one constructor invokes another constructor in the same class with `this(...)` or invokes a superclass constructor with `super(...)`. In inheritance, superclass construction happens before the subclass constructor body completes. AeroTopo's `Orthomosaic` constructor calls `super(id, tiles)`, which initializes Product state first; Product's shorter constructor also delegates with `this(id, List.of())`. This establishes inherited state before child-specific GSD validation and assignment.
